title: Samsung DW80 — Manual check mode
description: Manual Smart Install steps 1–7 (drain/fill, nozzle, heater, dispenser, fan, drain, auto door).

steps.title: Enter manual mode
steps.body: From AS: press Auto to cycle manual steps 1–7. Press Start to run selected step. Normal/Heavy keys adjust pump RPM and alternation in step 2.
